$why: The correction a retry carries is TEXT SENT TO A MODEL, and it was composed in engine code.
Every other instruction an agent receives lives in this layer, reviewable as prose; this one
was a template literal inside a shared library, so nobody auditing the prompts would ever
see the words that actually reach the model on a retry.
It is deliberately generic: it names no project, no agent, no artefact and no format. The
REASON and the previous answer are supplied by whichever call site rejected the answer, so
the same wording serves the vocabulary agent, the mint, and every parse site added later.
description: Tells an agent its previous answer was rejected, why, and what it sent.
body:
YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER WAS REJECTED: __REASON__

This is what you sent, and it could not be used:
---
__PREVIOUS_ANSWER__
---
Answer again in exactly the format requested. Change nothing else.
